job.title: Head of Major Projects Delivery
job.description:
Brisbane Airport is entering a significant period of investment and growth, creating an opportunity for an experienced major projects leader to play a key role in shaping and delivering the next generation of airport infrastructure.

Reporting to the Executive General Manager Capital Delivery, the Head of Major Projects Delivery will lead the delivery of Brisbane Airport Corporation’s most significant capital projects and expansion programs. With a strong focus on major building projects, the role is accountable for successful execution through detailed design, construction, operational readiness and handover.

This is a broad leadership role with responsibility for providing direction across the portfolio, leading high-performing project teams and overseeing contractors, consultants and delivery partners. Strong commercial and delivery discipline will be critical, ensuring projects achieve the right balance of safety, quality, cost and program outcomes.

The airport environment brings a unique level of complexity to major project delivery, with projects carefully integrated into existing operations and delivered in partnership with a diverse stakeholder group including airlines, tenants, government agencies, regulators and internal business stakeholders. Success will require sound judgement, strong stakeholder engagement capability and the ability to navigate competing priorities while maintaining momentum and a clear focus on delivery.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience delivering large-scale building projects within a similarly complex environment. A track record of leading projects valued above $100 million is essential, together with strong commercial capability across procurement, contracting, financial management and negotiation. Experience across both client and contractor environments would be highly regarded.

Beyond technical and commercial credentials, this role requires an experienced leader who builds trust and leads with transparency and accountability. Success will come from seeing major projects as part of the broader organisation rather than a portfolio operating in isolation, building strong relationships across BAC and understanding how delivery decisions impact the wider business. The ability to set clear direction and build capability within the team, while contributing as a senior leader across the enterprise, will be equally important.

This is an opportunity to lead a significant portfolio of projects that will help shape the future of Brisbane Airport and support its continued growth.

For an information pack please contact Gemma Ledbury at gemmaledbury@attunedtalent.com.au

job.title: General Manager People Experience
job.description:
About Dementia Australia
Dementia Australia is the national peak body supporting people living with dementia, their families and carers.

With approximately 600 employees nationally, the organisation’s work spans service delivery, research, policy and advocacy, fundraising, awareness, marketing and communications. At the heart of this work is a clear purpose - to reduce the impact of dementia for Australians of all ages.

The foundations are established, and the organisation is now entering its next stage of evolution with a strengthened Executive team and an ambition to build on what is already working well.

With strong employee engagement and an increasing focus on leadership capability, performance and organisational effectiveness, this is an opportunity to help shape what comes next.

The opportunity
Reporting to the Executive Director, People & Culture, the General Manager - People Experience will lead a broad national portfolio spanning business partnering, people advisory, policy, remuneration and benefits, employee value proposition and core People processes. The role will bring these areas together to deliver consistent, practical and contemporary support for leaders and employees.

This role has the scope to shape the People Experience function by strengthening its structure, capability, processes and ways of working. The focus is practical: enabling so leaders and employees to perform at their best and supported to deliver Dementia Australia’s purpose the organisation’s purpose.

You will:
  • Lead and develop a geographically dispersed People Experience team
  • Strengthen the HR Business Partnering model and elevate the function for greater impact
  • Lead the continued evolution of the employee experience and EVP
  • Oversee and drive effective People processes, policies and practices
  • Provide leadership across remuneration, benefits and contemporary People initiatives
  • Support organisational change, workforce transformation and capability uplift
  • Create greater consistency and connection across a national workforce
  • Partner with senior leaders to translate organisational priorities into practical People outcomes
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, innovate and improve the way People services are delivered
About you
We are looking for a commercial and contemporary People leader who combines curiosity and energy with the judgement and discipline to turn ideas into practical outcomes.

Your experience may come from a commercial, corporate, service-based or similarly complex environment. Sector experience is less important than your ability to lead a high-performing People function, bring fresh thinking and translate contemporary practice into outcomes that work in Dementia Australia’s context.

You will bring broad People leadership experience, strong business partnering capability and a track record of leading geographically dispersed teams through change and improvement. You will be confident addressing capability and performance, constructively challenging established ways of working, and translating strategic priorities into pragmatic delivery.

Importantly, you will be someone who can imagine what could be next - a leader who sees opportunities, creates solutions and brings people with them.

Why Dementia Australia?
This is an opportunity to bring your commercial People experience into an organisation where the work has genuine meaning.

Dementia Australia offers the opportunity to work nationally, influence senior leaders and shape a People Experience function with meaningful scope for improvement. You will join an organisation with strong foundations, an evolving leadership team and a clear ambition to create better experiences for its people and the Australians it serves.

Based in Milton, Brisbane, the role offers a hybrid working environment, with an expectation that this senior leader will also value the importance of visible leadership, connection and collaboration in the office and through some national travel.

For a People leader who wants the scope to shape, create and influence – while contributing to an organisation with genuine purpose – this is a compelling next move.

For a confidential discussion or to request further information, please contact Kate Vuleta, Director, Attuned Talent at katevuleta@attunedtalent.com.au

job.title: Head of Brand & Customer
job.description:
A fast-growing Australian e-commerce business is seeking an experienced brand and customer leader to help shape its next phase of growth.

This newly created role has a broad remit across customer strategy and insights, brand, engagement and experience, with the opportunity to build a deeper understanding of the customer and use that insight to shape strategy, challenge thinking and drive better commercial decisions.

Reporting to the CEO, you will lead and develop the function while building its influence across the organisation, working closely with e-commerce, buying, creative and operations to connect customer and brand thinking with product, experience and commercial performance.

Operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, you will be comfortable challenging the status quo, bringing a strong point of view and communicating strategy in a way that engages others. You will enjoy setting direction but be equally willing to get into the detail and work at pace to turn thinking into action.

Your background may have been built within e-commerce, retail, fashion or another fast-moving consumer environment, or within a strategic agency working closely with consumer and e-commerce brands. Either way, you will understand the commercial realities of e-commerce and have a strong track record of using customer insight to shape strategy, strengthen brands and drive growth.

Importantly, you will be able to bring others with you, building the credibility and value of the function and embedding customer thinking more deeply across the business.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to shape the agenda, build capability and have a meaningful impact on the next stage of growth for an ambitious Australian business.

Please email Gemma Ledbury at gemmaledbury@attunedtalent.com.au for an information pack.

job.title: Executive General Manager – People, Culture & Governance
job.description:
Brisbane Airport Corporation (BAC) operates one of Australia’s most important aviation and infrastructure assets – connecting Queensland to Australia and the world.

With approximately 500 employees, BAC is a relatively small organisation doing big things. Its scale, complexity and impact extend well beyond the size of its workforce, with a diverse operating environment spanning aviation, infrastructure, property, commercial operations and major projects.

BAC is entering its next phase of organisational evolution. With a refreshed executive structure and a clear focus on the future, there is an opportunity for an exceptional executive to join the leadership team as Executive General Manager – People, Culture & Governance.

The opportunity
Reporting directly to the CEO and as a key member of the Executive Leadership Team, the EGM People, Culture & Governance will lead a broad enterprise portfolio and play an influential role in shaping BAC’s future.

This is an executive role requiring both strategic perspective and the ability to operate effectively within a dynamic, highly visible environment. You will be a trusted adviser to the CEO, Board and executive team, bringing sound judgement, commercial thinking and a genuine commitment to people and organisational performance.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Lead the People, Culture & Governance portfolio, encompassing People & Culture, HSE, Legal and Company Secretariat.
  • Partner with the CEO, Board and Executive Leadership Team on organisational strategy, governance, risk and workforce priorities.
  • Lead the people and organisational elements of BAC’s next phase of change, building capability and supporting a high-performing culture.
  • Provide executive oversight across workforce strategy, employee and industrial relations, safety, wellbeing and compliance.
  • Ensure strong governance frameworks support effective decision-making and BAC’s broader strategic objectives.
  • Lead and develop a capable senior team, creating clarity, accountability and strong enterprise-wide partnerships.
  • Bring an enterprise mindset to the executive table, contributing beyond the functional portfolio to BAC’s overall performance and future direction.

About you
You will be an experienced executive who has operated in a complex, commercially focused organisation where people, governance, risk and reputation matter.

Your background may have been built through People & Culture leadership or a broader corporate portfolio; importantly, you will bring the executive maturity and breadth to lead across multiple disciplines.

You will bring:
  • Significant executive leadership experience within a complex organisation.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect people and organisational priorities to business outcomes.
  • Experience leading organisational change, transformation and capability uplift.
  • Credibility partnering with CEOs, Boards and senior executives.
  • Strong governance, risk and decision-making capability.
  • The ability to lead specialist functions through capable leaders rather than needing to be the technical expert in every discipline.
  • A pragmatic, contemporary and highly collaborative leadership style.

BAC’s leaders genuinely care about their people, and this role will suit an executive who shares that philosophy while also being prepared to challenge, influence and lead through change.

An airport is never static. BAC operates in an environment where today’s performance matters while the organisation continues to prepare for what comes next.

For the incoming EGM People, Culture & Governance, that creates a compelling mandate: respect what has made BAC successful, while helping shape what it needs to become.

This is an opportunity to join an organisation with the scale and complexity of a major enterprise, the connectivity of a relatively small workforce, and a leadership team ambitious about its next chapter.

How to apply
Attuned Talent has been exclusively engaged to manage this executive search.

For a confidential discussion or to request further information, please contact Kate Vuleta, Director, Attuned Talent at katevuleta@attunedtalent.com.au

job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
At Juma Consulting Engineers, they’re passionate about helping bring residential and commercial projects to life through quality pre-construction solutions. As a Brisbane-based business with more than 20 years of industry experience, their team delivers integrated services across building design, structural engineering, soil testing and energy efficiency, supporting projects from concept through to construction with practical expertise and a customer-first mindset.

They are now looking for an experienced Structural Engineer to join the team and take ownership of the commercial and light industrial segment of the business.

This is a hands-on technical opportunity for an engineer who genuinely enjoys the technical aspect and wants to remain close to the design and delivery of projects. While the primary focus will be commercial and light industrial work, there is plenty of variety across the broader business and the opportunity to become involved in more complex residential projects.

The Opportunity

Working closely with the Engineering Manager and broader technical team, you will take responsibility for the structural engineering and delivery of commercial and light industrial projects, with a significant proportion of the current portfolio comprising childcare centres and small warehouse developments.

Key Responsibilities
 
  • Lead the structural engineering and design delivery of commercial and light industrial projects
  • Manage projects across childcare centres, warehouses and other small-to-medium commercial developments
  • Undertake structural design across timber-frame, concrete and structural steel construction
  • Design and provide technical input across elements including tilt-up concrete panels, suspended slabs and steel structures
  • Independently manage technical deliverables and sign off engineering work as an RPEQ
  • Work collaboratively with clients, builders, designers and other project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle
  • Provide practical engineering solutions that balance technical requirements with buildability and commercial considerations
  • Contribute to high-end and multi-storey residential projects where required
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with existing clients and provide a responsive, solutions-focused service
  • Where appropriate, identify opportunities to strengthen existing relationships and contribute to new client and business development opportunities

As an RPEQ, you will have the capability and confidence to take ownership of your work and sign off your own projects.

About You
You are first and foremost a technical Structural Engineer who enjoys getting into the detail, solving engineering problems and delivering high-quality work. You are comfortable taking ownership of projects and enjoy working within a smaller business where you can remain hands-on and have genuine visibility over the outcomes you deliver.
You will ideally bring:
  • RPEQ registration, with the ability to independently sign off structural engineering work
  • Demonstrated structural engineering experience across commercial, light industrial and/or complex residential projects
  • Strong technical capability across timber-frame construction
  • Experience designing concrete structures, including exposure to tilt-up panels and suspended slabs
  • Strong understanding and experience across structural steel
  • The ability to independently manage projects from design through to delivery
  • A practical and solutions-focused approach to engineering and problem solving
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to confidently manage client and stakeholder relationships
  • A willingness to remain hands-on with technical engineering work rather than moving exclusively into people or project management
  • An interest in developing client relationships and, ideally, contributing to the growth of the commercial and light industrial portfolio
